title: Περὶ ὁμοίων καὶ διαφόρων λέξεων / De adfinium vocabulorum differentia (On Differences of Similar Words) / «О различии близких слов»
author: 'Ammonius' (perhaps reworking Herennius Philo of Byblos)
size: About 500 entries (estimate). Nickau's text is about 136 pp. Estimate 15k words.
ru_evidence: No ru.wikipedia article and no Russian translation found.
en_evidence: en.wikipedia (Ammonius Grammaticus) lists none. OpenAlex returns only reviews of Nickau's edition. No English translation found.
value: Ancient semantics through distinctions such as βίος/ζωή, famous via Agamben, and many others. Preserves Didymus and Tryphon. Useful for lexical semantics, NT and philosophy readers, and Greek teaching. Can be translated in full.
ai_feasibility: high: compact, structured entries. Nuances between near-synonyms need careful bilingual rendering, and a reviewer must check each distinction.
pilot_unit: Entire text, or letters Α–Ε as the pilot (estimate 4k words).
